title: GroundLink
description: The state of the link to the ground (CONTRACTS sections 12 and 26). Nothing on board waits on it: while it is down only ground messages and handoffs wait in the queue. Clients show status, next_contact_at and the gap words; nothing else changes when it is down. Only three readers may read it: the ground_log stage of a plan, the Habitat line and the ground_silence warning rule (EI1).

status.description: up: available for a near real time exchange. delayed: available, each message takes one_way_delay_s one way. down: no link; messages wait in the queue until it is up or delayed again.

anyOf.description: The one-way delay a message takes when the link is available. Kept while the link is down. Null when unknown.

source.description: schedule: from the active environment profile's comms_queue. measured: reported by a comms adapter (no adapter is defined in this package). demo_switch: set with POST /v1/demo/ground-link.

delay_text.description: earth_delay of the active environment in environment-hazards.json with parenthesised source IDs removed, for example Seconds. NASA gives 6 to 10 seconds on the surface of the Moon as an example of a small delay.

gap_planned.description: True when the gap is in the environment's contact schedule or was set as planned by the demo switch. A planned gap raises nothing; only silence past next_contact_at plus the ground_silence threshold raises a warning (CONTRACTS section 26).
